newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * The foreign policy commission of Romania's lower Chamber of Deputies will send a letter to the U.S. Congress asking for support for Romania's NATO integration, said commission chief Victor Bostinaru.
In a statement to be issued next week, the Romanian parliament will ask the parliaments of NATO members to support Romania's bid to join NATO in the first wave of enlargement.

* Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea reiterated Romania's proposal that neighbouring Moldova join in the construction of a new reactor at the Cernavoda nuclear plant, during talks with visiting Moldovan Foreign Minister Mihai Popov.
Popov said Moldovan Prime Minister Ion Ciubuc would visit Romania later in May. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
